question: What dual role does the arisen kṛtyā fulfill toward the fire and the ritual performer?
premises: The kṛtyā enters the fire again.
The kṛtyā is associated with the performer of the rite.
The kṛtyā acts as a protector.
inference: The kṛtyā re-enters the fire and also protects the performer of the rite.
plain_english: This kṛtyā enters the fire again and also protects the doer.
